title: Toxicity Red-Teaming: Benchmarking LLM Safety in Singapore’s Low-Resource Languages
findings: Mistral consistently exhibited religious bias, frequently selecting Muslims in Singlish and Hindus in Chinese. SEA-LION showed lower religious bias, particularly in Singlish. Qwen and LLaMA-3.1 generated a higher proportion of 'Invalid' responses, indicating stronger safety mechanisms in religious contexts.
